title: EEG shuts down inside Homestead 2

tellings.quote: I think you walked into the homestead and the EEG shut down. And then he walked out and it was back online and it was super strange.

plain: An EEG, a machine that records brain waves, is said to have shut down when someone carrying it walked into Homestead 2, a building on Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, a property known for reports of strange events, and to have come back on as soon as he walked out. Michels recalls this himself to his guest, the ranch's owner, sometime in the 2020s, calling it super strange. If true, it would suggest something in that building interferes with electronics.
